nodes.name: Wasender · send-message
nodes.notes: Attach an n8n 'Header Auth' credential: Name = Authorization, Value = Bearer <WASENDER_PRIVATE_API_TOKEN>. The token lives ONLY in this credential — never in the workflow JSON, never in the CRM bundle.

nodes.name: Update message status
nodes.notes: Header Auth credential: Name = Authorization, Value = Bearer <SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY>. Set SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY as n8n environment variables.

meta.description: Outbound-only alternative to the wa-send Edge Function. Import into n8n, attach the two Header Auth credentials described in the node notes, activate, then paste the production webhook URL into WEPRO CRM → Conversations → Chat Settings → Relay URL. Inbound stays on the wa-webhook Edge Function, which mirrors WhatsApp media into Supabase Storage and guards against replayed deliveries.
